_note: siteUrl: the live address, e.g. https://www.example.com (used for the sitemap and canonical links; leave empty until the domain is live). dataVerified: true once broker figures in content/brokers.json have been checked against each broker's website (they were on 2026-09-29; see each broker's sources). Brokers whose own 'verified' flag is false still get a notice and noindex on their review page. guidesFcaOnly: when true, the 'best' guides and homepage top picks only rank FCA-authorised brokers (right for a UK audience); set false to rank every broker.
